acct_sync_error_body: The server is not answering. Your attempts are safe on this device and sync will retry by itself.
acct_sync_rejected: Attempts the server refused: {n} — their keystroke log did not pass the check. They stay in this device's history.
acct_guest_body: You are playing as a guest: progress lives in this browser only. Sign in with Google and your level, attempts and settings follow you to any device.
acct_anon_body: You are playing as a guest named {nick}. Sign in with Google and your nick, races and progress stay yours on any device.
acct_privacy: Only your nick is public. Nobody sees your Google email, name or photo.
acct_no_backend: Sign-in is unavailable right now: the server cannot be reached. Training works without it — progress stays in this browser.
acct_nick_taken: That nick is taken. Try another one.
acct_nick_invalid: A nick is 2 to 32 characters long.
acct_nick_signed_out: The account cannot be reached right now. Try again in a minute.
acct_nick_failed: The nick was not saved. Try again.
acct_signout_pending_title: Not everything is in the cloud yet
acct_signout_pending_body: Attempts that have not reached the cloud yet: {n}. Signing out removes progress from this browser, so they must be saved first. Check the connection and try again.
acct_delete_body: This deletes your account, nick, every attempt and race result — in the cloud and in this browser. Groups you created pass to their oldest member. It cannot be undone.
acct_delete_failed: Your data was not deleted: the server did not answer. Nothing changed — try again.
acct_taken_title: This Google account already has progress on another device
acct_taken_body: We will sign you into it and add this browser's attempts to it — nothing gets lost.
acct_taken_note: Races you ran here as a guest stay under the guest nick.
acct_failed_body: Google did not confirm the sign-in. Your progress is safe in this browser — try again a little later.
acct_toast_signed_in: You are signed in. Progress is syncing.
acct_toast_signed_out: You are signed out. This browser's progress was removed — it is safe in the cloud.
